description: Lists the Google Drive files the account opened most recently, or the ones modified most recently, the most recent at the top. Returns one compact entry per file: its ID, name, MIME type, when it was last modified, when the account last opened it, and its link, plus a page token when more remain. Files in Trash are left out.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

by.description: Order by when the account last opened each file, or by when each file was last modified by anyone (default: opened).

page_size.description: The most files to return in one page (default: 20, at most 100).

page_token.description: The nextPageToken from an earlier call, to read the page after it.

name: gws-mcp__drive_list_recent_files
